mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and ototoxic; clarithromycin may inhibit gentamicin clearance via CYP3A4 effects on renal function, increasing gentamicin accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, BUN, and gentamicin levels closely; consider alternative macrolide (azithromycin) or aminoglycoside; assess renal function before and during therapy.
